summary: Completed comprehensive E3 (Cart, Checkout & Orders) testing. Backend: 95/96 tests passed (99%). Frontend: All critical flows working - guest checkout, voucher application, auth, order history, order cancellation, and success page rendering.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/orders as guest - returns 200 with order code CP######## (10 chars), status=pending, payment_status=belum_bayar
Backend: POST /api/orders with voucher WELCOME10 - discount applied (10%), voucher_code set, used_count increments
Backend: Anti-oversell - quantity > stock returns 409 with available count; quantity >= 1000000 returns 422
Backend: Invalid inputs - nonexistent product_id returns 400; invalid shipping_id returns 400 (NOT 5xx)
Backend: GET /api/orders without auth returns 401; with Bearer returns user's orders only
Backend: GET /api/orders/{code} - owner gets 200; non-owner gets 404 (IDOR-safe)
Backend: POST /api/orders/{code}/cancel - owner on pending returns 200 with status=cancelled; non-owner gets 404
Backend: GET /api/shipping-methods returns 5 methods; GET /api/payment-methods returns 8 methods with groups (transfer, ewallet, cod); GET /api/settings returns settings object
Backend: GET /api/cart without auth returns 401; with auth returns cart; PUT /api/cart with auth persists cart
Backend: Auth flow - register, login, /api/auth/me all working correctly
Frontend: Guest checkout happy path - add to cart, checkout, fill address, apply voucher WELCOME10 (discount Rp 49.500), place order, redirect to /pesanan-sukses with code CP00000037
Frontend: Shipping options and payment tabs (Transfer/E-Wallet/COD) load from API correctly
Frontend: Address dialog - all fields (name, phone, street, city, province, postal) working, save button persists address
Frontend: Voucher application - WELCOME10 applied, discount shows in checkout-discount-amount, total updates correctly
Frontend: Auth on /akun - login with customer@collectorparfum.id works, profile card displays, order history loads (3 orders found)
Frontend: Cancel order - order CP00000036 cancelled successfully, status changed to 'DIBATALKAN' after refresh
Frontend: OrderSuccessPage - valid code CP00000037 renders order summary with payment instructions and total Rp 464.500
Frontend: OrderSuccessPage - invalid code CPINVALID99 renders not-found state without crashing
